principles: Al-Quran is the primary/Muhaimin source for the engine.
Tawrat, Zabur, and Injil are complementary revelation references when a trusted local corpus/witness is available.
No hadith, tafsir, scholarly opinion, historical chronology, medical source, legal source, news source, or web research receives normative engine weight.
A modern textual witness is never silently equated with the original revelation.
Place mentioned in a passage is not automatically the place where that passage was revealed.
Unavailable scripture corpus remains unavailable; the engine must not synthesize missing scripture from model memory.
Divine Names/Attributes are discovered from admitted revelation corpora; no human-curated 99-name catalog is normative or required.
Language/query adapters have zero normative authority: they may form corpus-search surfaces but may not contain action-to-verse mappings, moral direction, or moral score.
